-- Tuples: two or more values kept together. Build one with (a, b), take it apart with `match`.
type Move = Step((Int, Int)) | Stay

fn swap(p: (Int, Text)) -> (Text, Int)
  intent "Exchange the two parts of a pair."
  example swap((1, "a")) == ("a", 1)
  example swap((0, "")) == ("", 0)
do
  match p do
    case (n, t) =>
      return (t, n)
  end match
end fn

fn min_max(a: Int, b: Int) -> (Int, Int)
  intent "The smaller and the larger of two numbers, in that order."
  ensures out_lo(out) <= out_hi(out)
  example min_max(5, 2) == (2, 5)
  example min_max(1, 1) == (1, 1)
do
  if a <= b then
    return (a, b)
  else
    return (b, a)
  end if
end fn

fn out_lo(p: (Int, Int)) -> Int
  example out_lo((3, 4)) == 3
do
  match p do
    case (lo, _) =>
      return lo
  end match
end fn

fn out_hi(p: (Int, Int)) -> Int
  example out_hi((3, 4)) == 4
do
  match p do
    case (_, hi) =>
      return hi
  end match
end fn

fn fizz(n: Int) -> Text
  intent "FizzBuzz for one number, by matching both remainders at once."
  example fizz(15) == "FizzBuzz"
  example fizz(9) == "Fizz"
  example fizz(10) == "Buzz"
  example fizz(7) == "7"
do
  match (n % 3, n % 5) do
    case (0, 0) =>
      return "FizzBuzz"
    case (0, _) =>
      return "Fizz"
    case (_, 0) =>
      return "Buzz"
    case _ =>
      return int.to_text(n)
  end match
end fn

fn add_options(a: Option<Int>, b: Option<Int>) -> Int
  intent "Sum of the values that are present; every combination is a case."
  example add_options(some(1), some(2)) == 3
  example add_options(some(4), none) == 4
  example add_options(none, some(5)) == 5
  example add_options(none, none) == 0
do
  match (a, b) do
    case (some(x), some(y)) =>
      return x + y
    case (some(x), none) =>
      return x
    case (none, some(y)) =>
      return y
    case (none, none) =>
      return 0
  end match
end fn

fn span(r: ((Int, Int), (Int, Int))) -> Int
  intent "Manhattan distance between the two corners of a rectangle."
  example span(((0, 0), (3, 4))) == 7
  example span(((5, 5), (1, 2))) == 7
do
  match r do
    case ((x1, y1), (x2, y2)) =>
      return abs_diff(x1, x2) + abs_diff(y1, y2)
  end match
end fn

fn abs_diff(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  example abs_diff(2, 7) == 5
  example abs_diff(7, 2) == 5
do
  if a < b then
    return b - a
  else
    return a - b
  end if
end fn

fn div_mod(a: Int, b: Int) -> Result<(Int, Int), Text>
  intent "Quotient and remainder, or an error for a zero divisor."
  example div_mod(7, 2) == ok((3, 1))
  example div_mod(1, 0) == err("division by zero")
do
  if b == 0 then
    return err("division by zero")
  else
    return ok((a / b, a % b))
  end if
end fn

fn apply_move(pos: (Int, Int), m: Move) -> (Int, Int)
  intent "A position after a step; staying keeps it."
  example apply_move((1, 1), Step((2, -1))) == (3, 0)
  example apply_move((1, 1), Stay) == (1, 1)
do
  match m do
    case Step((dx, dy)) =>
      match pos do
        case (x, y) =>
          return (x + dx, y + dy)
      end match
    case Stay =>
      return pos
  end match
end fn

fn sum_pairs(ps: List<(Int, Int)>) -> List<Int>
  intent "The sum of each pair."
  example sum_pairs([(1, 2), (3, 4)]) == [3, 7]
  example sum_pairs([]) == []
do
  return list.map(ps, pair_sum)
end fn

fn pair_sum(p: (Int, Int)) -> Int
  example pair_sum((10, 20)) == 30
do
  match p do
    case (a, b) =>
      return a + b
  end match
end fn

fn labelled(n: Int) -> (Int, (Bool, Text))
  intent "A number with a nested pair describing it."
  example labelled(4) == (4, (true, "even"))
  example labelled(3) == (3, (false, "odd"))
do
  let even = n % 2 == 0
  let label = if_even(even)
  let detail = (even, label)
  return (n, detail)
end fn

fn if_even(even: Bool) -> Text
  example if_even(true) == "even"
  example if_even(false) == "odd"
do
  match even do
    case true =>
      return "even"
    case false =>
      return "odd"
  end match
end fn
